The container list is in; now checking which drop-in container bodea's `product-list` block actually mounts, plus the slot details.

The block (bodea's `product-list-page`) is built on the product-discovery drop-in. It renders four containers; two of them expose slots.

**SearchResults** — the product grid. Slots let you replace pieces of each product card or the list frame:

| Slot | For |
|---|---|
| `ProductImage` | The card's image (context includes the default image props, so you can wrap or swap it) |
| `ProductName` | The product title/link |
| `ProductPrice` | The price display |
| `ProductActions` | The card's buttons (add to cart, wishlist, etc.) |
| `Header` | Content above the grid (gets the current products + search variables) |
| `Footer` | Content below the grid (same context) |
| `NoResults` | The empty state when a search returns nothing |

**Facets** — the filter sidebar:

| Slot | For |
|---|---|
| `Facets` | The whole facet list |
| `Facet` | One facet group (e.g. "Color") |
| `FacetHeading` | A facet group's title |
| `FacetBucket` | One filter option row within a group |
| `FacetBucketLabel` | Just the label text of an option |
| `SelectedFacets` | The "applied filters" chips area |

**SortBy** and **Pagination** are also rendered by the block but have no slots — customizing those means replacing the container, not slotting into it.

said: Working on bodea — I'll pull the slot list from the drop-ins tooling.
The tooling doesn't have a container literally named "product-list," so let me confirm which drop-in container the bodea block actually mounts.

The product list in bodea is the **product-list-page** block, and its product grid is the SearchResults drop-in container. That container exposes seven slots:

| Slot | What it's for |
|---|---|
| **ProductImage** | Each card's image (bodea already overrides this to link the image and use AEM Assets) |
| **ProductName** | Each card's product name/title |
| **ProductPrice** | Each card's price display |
| **ProductActions** | Buttons on each card (bodea overrides this for add-to-cart, wishlist, requisition list) |
| **Header** | Area above the whole result grid — gets the product list and search parameters |
| **Footer** | Area below the whole result grid — same context as Header |
| **NoResults** | What shows when the search returns nothing — gets the error and the query that failed |

The same block also mounts the Facets container (the filter sidebar), which has its own six slots if you want to restyle filtering: **Facets**, **Facet**, **FacetHeading**, **FacetBucket**, **FacetBucketLabel**, and **SelectedFacets** — covering the full facet list, one facet group, its heading, one filter option, that option's label, and the applied-filters row, respectively.

So if you're planning a customization: card-level changes go in the first four SearchResults slots, grid-level framing in Header/Footer, empty-state in NoResults.
